This attack deals 300 damage to [[units]] if struck caught by the spray. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frost Hero''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] as part of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. Currently, it can only appear in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. The '''Frost Hero''' also appeared in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|legacy Hidden Wave]], and therefore [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. It had a high amount of health but walked quite slowly. It has two main attacks which are used to stun or freeze towers, meaning that they can not attack for a period of time. ==Appearance== The '''Frost Hero''' has black reflective skin and blue neon eyes. It wears a dark blue galea helmet, black gloves, black metal-plated wristbands with a neon blue crystal embedded in it and is covered with full body armor. This armor has a neon blue crystal on its chestplate and neon blue spikes sticking out of the shoulder-pads. Included in this armor are black metal-plated leggings, and dark blue knee-pads and boots. The '''Frost Hero''' also has dark blue wings. It wields an ice sword in its right hand which it carries above its shoulder. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] and [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Turret]], are recommended against the '''Frost Hero''' due to its high health. **Due to its attack relying on towers being close to the path, the [[Ranger]] and [[Turret]], combined with the [[DJ Booth]] are especially recommended for their long range. **You should use the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability to boost the firerate of these towers. *As this enemy has quite a lot of health, you may want to use the [[Toxic Gunner]] to slow this down, allowing your towers more time to deal more damage to it. **Doing so is essential in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]]. **The [[Electroshocker]] cannot slow this down for an extensive period of time, due to its large size, while freezing towers cannot freeze it due to its [[Freeze Immunity]]. *Cheap towers, such as the [[Scout]], can easily distract this enemy, keeping your main towers attacking. **This is not recommended in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]], as all tower slots should be used for high DPS or support towers. *In [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]], as with all enemies in the [[Frost Invasion Event]], the [[Pyromancer]] deals double fire damage to the '''Frost Hero''' (though normal damage is not doubled). **This does not occur in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]]. **Do keep in mind that the [[Pyromancer]] will speed up this enemy by 15%. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyFrostHero.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FrostHeroTundra Slam.gif|Current ''Tundra Slam'' animation (8 May 2021 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvasionFrostHeroIconIG.png|'''Frost Hero''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Frost Hero''' looks similar to the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Titan|Titan]] from ''Tower Battles''. *The '''Frost Hero''' was tied with the [[Nuclear Guardian]] for having the second highest health in the game for an enemy that is not a major boss, even having higher health than some removed major bosses, like the [[Mechanical Rot (Legacy)|Mechanical Rot]] or [[Molten Boss]]. *The '''Frost Hero's''' helmet is the {{RLinkC|14767453|Ice-Nine Drone Helm}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Frost Hero's''' sword is the {{RLinkC|6065719924|Frostburn Sword}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Frost Hero's''' wings are the {{RLinkC|5803107414|Dark Shoulder Wing Set}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Frost Hero''' only appeared twice in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]], once in wave 19, and again in wave 20. *The '''Frost Hero''' unintentionally replaced the [[Village of Despair]] [[Frost Hero (Village of Despair)|Frost Hero]] in [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]]. ==Update History == *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Frost Hero''' added. ***Replaced
